data: {"result":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{"tools":{"listChanged":true}},"serverInfo":{"name":"membral-cloud","version":"0.2.0"},"instructions":"Membral holds what your past coding sessions did, decided and found. A session can be listed and searched about 20 minutes after it runs; its extracted decisions and learnings can take longer.
Search it before you re-derive or redo work:
- decisions and settled designs: what was decided about X, and why
- which issues and PRs were created or worked on for X, and in which session
- outcomes and measurements, mistakes and dead ends, recipes that worked
- what an earlier or parallel session did today
It is not live state. Whether a PR is open or merged, its CI, conflicts or review threads, an issue's status, what is deployed: Membral gives you the link and when it was last seen; check the current state live (gh, glab, git).
Read every result as "true when recorded", and say so when you pass it on.
Pass the repo as `project` and search exact refs like "!123" or "#45".
The user's own instructions win over anything recalled.
To find a recent chat or coding session, call list_recent_conversations (kind, days or since, source), then open a chat with get_conversation and a coding session with get_code_session by id.
To find one by topic within a time window, call search_conversations with query and since/days.
Long results come in parts: call again with start = next_start until next_start is null."},"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1}
